resources.string: Back up settings, profiles, configuration files and their local resources together.
Backups may contain subscription links and WebDAV credentials. Keep them private.
Restore profiles, local resources and settings, including the saved WebDAV connection.
Restore profiles and their local resources. Keep current settings and WebDAV connection.
Update matching backup profiles and add missing ones. Keep other profiles.
Replace the profile list with this backup. Other profiles will be removed; the active connection may need to update.
Set up a WebDAV connection to upload, browse and restore backups.
The backup is checked before any data is replaced. Restoring may update the active connection.
Upload a complete backup. An existing file with this name will be overwritten.
This permanently deletes the backup from the server.
Remove the saved server and credentials. Remote backup files will remain.
Use an HTTPS WebDAV address. The server is contacted only when you check, list or transfer backups.
Leave the password empty to keep the saved password for this server and account.
Checking and restoring data. Please wait…
Unable to load backup settings. Try again.
Unable to save restore options. Try again.
Unable to save the WebDAV connection. Try again.
Check the HTTPS address and use a plain .zip filename.
Enter an account and password, or choose anonymous access. A different server or account needs its own password.
The server denied access. Check the account and password.
The remote backup or folder was not found. Refresh the list or check the server address.
The server could not replace or delete this file. Check its permissions and try again.
Unable to complete the WebDAV request. Check the connection and try again.
Unable to access the selected document. Select it again and grant access.
Unable to open this backup. Select the file again.
Unable to save the backup. Choose a destination and try again.
This backup could not be restored. It may be damaged, unsupported or contain invalid data. Existing data was kept.
This backup enables starting at boot. Grant VPN permission in the app first, or restore profiles only.
Data was restored, but the app could not refresh. Retry refresh before continuing. The backup will not be applied again.
The unfinished file could not be removed. Retry cleanup, or delete that file in your document provider.
